title: Palantir / WEF Data Equity output-network closure depth 5
summary: At the configured depth-5 boundary, the direct Palantir-linked WEF Data Equity network remains person-centered:Katherine Hsiao is a named 2023 author/council member and a named 2024 council contributor while explicitly affiliated with Palantir in both report rosters. The reviewed sources do not establish Palantir corporate authorship, sponsorship, control, policy adoption or a second Palantir participant.

gaps: The exact start/end dates of Hsiao's earlier Global Future Council for Data Policy service remain unresolved.

provenance.method: max-depth synthesis of WEF publication metadata, report contributor rosters and WEF person-profile evidence

data.question: What is the strongest defensible Palantir-linked WEF Data Equity network claim after the full five-depth root recursion?
data.method: Synthesize direct person-to-publication, person-to-council and person-to-employer evidence across the 2023 and 2024 reports; explicitly reject stronger institution-level claims not supported by the sources.
data.scope: Katherine Hsiao, Palantir Technologies and WEF Data Equity council outputs in 2023-2024.
findings: Katherine Hsiao is directly listed among the authors of the 2023 WEF Data Equity briefing paper and the report contributor page lists her as Executive Vice-President and Head of Health and Life Sciences, Palantir Technologies.
The 2024 Advancing Data Equity contributor section again lists Hsiao as a Global Future Council on Data Equity member with the same Palantir role.
WEF's official 2024 publication page states that Advancing Data Equity was produced by members of the Global Future Council on Data Equity; it does not assign institutional authorship to Palantir.
Across the reviewed Data Equity publication, contributor and profile surfaces, Hsiao remains the only directly resolved Palantir-personnel bridge.
No reviewed source establishes that Palantir Technologies sponsored, controlled, authored as an institution, or caused adoption of the council's recommendations.

WEF's current Hsiao profile separately says she recently served on the Global Future Council for Data Policy, while the 2023 and 2024 artifacts place her on the Global Future Council on Data Equity; the exact chronology between those council roles remains unresolved.
conclusions: The bounded network supports a durable person-level edge:Hsiao, while a Palantir executive, participated in consecutive WEF Data Equity outputs across 2023 and 2024.
The evidence ceiling stops at named person participation and contemporaneous employer affiliation. Stronger claims about Palantir institutional influence are unsupported by the reviewed record.
The configured depth-5 root is complete and should not be silently extended.
limitations: The official 2024 PDF host was not directly retrievable in this environment, and exhaustive negative claims about all Palantir personnel are not possible from public search coverage alone.
unresolved: Exact Data Policy council term dates for Hsiao.
